core_obligations: (1) implies (2): base change a locally quasi-finite morphism of algebraic spaces along the field point and use the scheme-free statement that its fibre is discrete (proof lines 4928-4932)

(2) implies (1): present the target by a scheme and check the property of being locally quasi-finite along that cover; the base-changed morphism is locally of finite type by assumption and its field fibres are discrete, so the characterization for algebraic spaces applies (proof lines 4933-4946)
proof_roadmap: (1)⇒(2)：把 X_k → Spec(k) 看作 f 的基变换，局部拟有限 ⇒ 点空间离散。
(2)⇒(1)：取概型 V 满光滑映到 Y，只需证 V ×_Y X → V 局部拟有限；它局部有限型、且各域上纤维离散，用代数空间的刻画即得。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism of algebraic stacks representable by algebraic spaces is locally quasi-finite if and only if it is locally of finite type and the space of every field-valued fibre is discrete (author lemma at source lines 4913-4925, label lemma-representable-by-spaces-quasi-finite). The proof (source lines 4927-4948) treats the forward direction by base change to a field, and the reverse direction by presenting the target, checking the property along the cover and applying the characterization for algebraic spaces (proof lines 4928-4946). The reduction through a smooth cover and the application of the scheme-free characterization are the content. H3.
